title: Líder de Manutenção
description:
Overview

Se você procura boas oportunidades para sua carreira e deseja atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, desafiador, agradável, inclusivo e diverso, a FQM é o lugar certo. Se você tem interesse e perfil para fazer parte do nosso time, aplique-se à seleção.

Perfil

  • Tenha facilidade de relacionamento com diferentes perfis.
  • Possua visão analítica e orientada a dados.
  • Tenha habilidade de comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Possua resiliência para situações adversas.
  • Tenha brilho nos olhos e seja protagonista da sua carreira.
  • Seu lugar é aqui!

Requisitos

  • Formação em Engenharia (Mecânica, Elétrica, Mecatrônica, Produção ou áreas afins).
  • Experiência em funções de manutenção, sendo em indústrias de fármacos, cosméticos ou similares (altamente reguladas).
  • Conhecimento sólido em equipamentos farmacêuticos e cosméticos: Máquinas de envase de líquidos (enchedoras, lavadoras, tampadoras); Linhas de pomadas e cremes (tancagem, homogeneização, enchimento); Equipamentos de embalagem (cartonadoras, blisteradoras, etiquetadoras); Máquinas de sachê (formação, enchimento e selagem).
  • Experiência com sistemas de automação industrial (CLPs, inversores de frequência, IHMs).
  • Domínio da análise de OEE e utilização de KPIs para gestão da área.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão de manutenção, como: SAP PM.
  • Certificação em metodologias Lean Six Sigma (Yellow, Green Belt).
  • Experiência com abertura e gestão de mudanças e documentos de qualificação de equipamentos.

Responsabilidades

Gestão da Manutenção

  • Planejar, coordenar e executar as atividades de manutenção preventiva e corretiva em toda a linha de produção.
  • Realizar análise de causas raiz (RCA) para falhas recorrentes ou críticas em equipamentos, propondo e implementando soluções definitivas.
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de performance, com ênfase em OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), atuando para melhorar a disponibilidade, performance e qualidade dos equipamentos.
  • Garantir a rápida resposta e resolução de paradas não planejadas, minimizando o impacto na produção.

Gestão de Pessoas

  • Liderar, desenvolver e motivar a equipe de técnicos de manutenção (mecânica e elétrica).
  • Realizar avaliações de desempenho (técnica e comportamental) da equipe, identificando necessidades de treinamento e planos de desenvolvimento.
  • Organizar e distribuir as ordens de serviço, garantindo a produtividade e a aderência aos procedimentos de segurança e qualidade.

Engenharia e Melhoria Contínua

  • Desenvolver, revisar e atualizar Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POP's) para as atividades de manutenção.
  • Aplicar conceitos de Lean Manufacturing (como 5S, Kaizen, SMED) na área de manutenção para eliminar desperdícios e aumentar a eficiência.
  • Possuir conhecimento em automação industrial para interagir com sistemas de controle e apoiar a solução de problemas complexos.
  • Participar de projetos de melhoria e modernização de equipamentos.

Conformidade e Segurança

  • Assegurar que todas as atividades de manutenção sejam realizadas em estrita conformidade com as Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF) e normas regulatórias (ANVISA, FDA).
  • Garantir o cumprimento de todas as normas de segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente.
  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado.
  • Alimentação no Local.
  • Vale-alimentação.
  • Assistência médica (plano Bradesco ou Unimed).
  • Assistência odontológica (Odontoprev).
  • Auxílio academia (Wellhub/Gympass).
  • Crédito consignado.
  • Participação nos lucros ou resultados.
  • Seguro pet.
  • Previdência privada.
  • Medicamentos gratuitos.
  • Cartão farmácia.
  • Auxílio ótica.
  • Auxílio educação.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • E muito mais!

*Todas as vagas são elegíveis a pessoas com deficiência.

title: Power Electronics Developer
description:
Select how often (in days) to receive an alert:

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

About Us: At TechnipFMC, within the Controls & Automation product line, we are pioneering technology platforms for the electrification of Subsea Control Systems and the advancement of renewable energy sources such as offshore wind, hydrogen, and wave energy.

Our Team: The Electronics R&D team works across a broad spectrum of technologies, including analog electronics, FPGA, SoC, power design, safety design, motor controllers, processor design, and power line modems. These technologies are integral to various control system applications.

Your Role: As part of the Controls & Automation team at TechnipFMC, you will engage in the design, development, qualification, system integration, and production of new products, from commissioning to field operation. Our multidisciplinary development environment includes HW, SW, system, test, mechatronics, and production engineering teams working collaboratively.

We are seeking Senior Power Electronics Developers with expertise in motor control and battery management systems to join our Hardware development team.

Job Description

  • Define hardware requirements in collaboration with system, drive train, and battery management system architects and developers.
  • Design and develop motor drive and battery management circuits, PCBAs, and modules, including component selection, schematic drawing, PCB layout, and prototype building.
  • Conduct functional verification of motor drive and battery management system circuits, PCBAs, sub-assemblies, and electrical actuators.
  • Collaborate with systems architects, mechanical designers, PCB layout, manufacturing, reliability, and SW engineering teams to design and develop power electronics products.
  • Create test procedures and write test reports on functional, environmental, system operation mode, and manufacturing testing of custom power electronic designs.

You are meant for this job if:

  • Analog electronics, including discrete design with Opamps, transistors, inductors, transformers, and capacitors for high voltage designs.
  • Component selection of high voltage power semiconductors (IGBTs, MOSFETs, diodes) for gate drives and analog/digital measurement circuits.
  • Power electronics design across various topologies in the AC or DC domain for motor controllers, battery management circuits, power supplies, and switches.
  • Schematic design and PCB layout using ECAD tools like Altium Designer or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of motor drive and battery control topologies, semiconductor component performance, and loss mechanisms.
  • Experience with lab instruments such as oscilloscopes, network analyzers, signal generators, programmable loads, motor, and battery simulators.
  • Expertise in PCB layout for optimal component placement, reduced stray inductance/capacitance, improved manufacturability, and EMC compliance.
  • Knowledge of control algorithms and embedded programming for circuit design verification.
  • Experience in power electronics design optimized for DFX requirements (manufacturability and testability).
  • Understanding of EMC requirements and CE certification relevant to motor controller design in control system applications.

Qualifications:

  • BSc, MSc, or PhD in electronics, automation, cybernetics, or a related engineering field.
  • 3-5 years of industrial experience in relevant power electronics development and industrialization.
  • Ability to approach complex problems structurally.
  • Open-minded, professional English proficiency, and adaptability to work in a multicultural environment.
  • Continuously raising standards, innovative, and solution oriented.
  • Interest in electronics is an additional advantage.

What We Offer:

  • Engaging tasks and work-life balance.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Training and career development opportunities.
  • Comprehensive insurance and pension plans.

Skills

Being a global leader in the energy industry requires an inclusive and diverse environment. TechnipFMC promotes equal opportunities and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matter and we encourage you to add to our culture.

TechnipFMC respects the rights and dignity of those it works with and promotes adherence to internationally recognized human rights principles for those in its value chain.

title: OPERADOR (A) PERTENCER PCD
description:
Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.

Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.

Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo(B3) e Nova Iorque(NYSE).

Programa Pertencer – Gerdau

A Gerdau está sempre em busca de formas de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro. Por isso, em parceria com a Firjan e com certificação do SENAI, desenvolvemos o Programa Pertencer , uma iniciativa de capacitação profissional voltada exclusivamente para mulheres e pessoas com deficiência.

Para nós, “Pertencer” significa mais do que estar em um lugar onde a diversidade é respeitada, é também perceber que ela é, de fato, valorizada.

Objetivo do programa

O objetivo do programa é capacitar mulheres e pessoas com deficiência interessadas em ingressar no ambiente industrial da empresa . Essa é uma porta de entrada para a companhia e visa habilitar novos profissionais para atuar na indústria, não sendo exigida experiência prévia .

Público-alvo:

  • Pessoas com deficiência;
  • A partir de 18 anos;
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Preferencialmente residentes da Zona Oeste do RJ, Itaguaí ou Seropédica , nas proximidades da Usina Cosigua .

Local:

Usina Cosigua – Rio de Janeiro/RJ

✨ O que buscamos:

  • Vontade de aprender e se desenvolver;
  • Senso de resolução de problemas;
  • Habilidades de comunicação;
  • Proatividade, espírito colaborativo e autonomia.

O que oferecemos:

  • Assistência médica SULAMERICA ou UNIMED Nacional (sem carência);
  • Pronto atendimento virtual Hospital Albert Einstein;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Refeição na empresa;
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Transporte fretado;
  • Benefício farmácia, fisioterapia e dentista;
  • Previdência privada;

Etapas do processo seletivo:

  • Triagem dos requisitos;

  • Entrevista com a Área de Pessoas e líder da área operacional;
  • Visita à área;
  • Exames admissionais;
  • Entrega da documentação;
  • Admissão.

DIVERSIDADE É O QUE NOS MOVE.

Para nós, a diversidade e a inclusão são valores fundamentais . Entendemos que pessoas, independentemente da idade, características físicas ou individuais, devem se sentir seguras e representar na Gerdau o extrato real da sociedade.

Seguiremos valorizando a diversidade e promovendo a inclusão , buscando de forma intencional a participação de mulheres e pessoas com deficiência para desenvolver novos talentos e aumentar a equidade na Gerdau.

Na Gerdau, diversidade e inclusão são compromissos reais . Todas as pessoas qualificadas serão consideradas para as vagas, sem distinção de gênero, idade, raça, religião, orientação sexual, nacionalidade ou deficiência .

Se interessou? Participe do Programa Pertencer e construa seu futuro com a gente!

Temos como princípio a promoção de um ambiente diverso e inclusivo. Respeitamos e valorizamos a diversidade, por isso todas as pessoas qualificadas serão consideradas para as vagas sem distinção de deficiência, gênero, idade, identidade ou orientação sexual, nacionalidade, raça, religião, ou qualquer outra característica.

We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

You'll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end—from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high‑quality software—and help the team grow in the process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non‑functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards.
  • Build and deliver using our technology stack with focus on quality, performance, and observability.
  • Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium‑sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on‑time delivery.
  • Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders.
  • Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality.
  • Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools.
  • Client interaction: attend remote and in‑person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade‑offs, and present solutions clearly.
  • Mentor others: guide mid‑level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture.
  • Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals.
  • Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post‑mortems.
  • Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
  • Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects.
  • Stack: Backend (Java, Python and .Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event‑driven architectures.
  • Cloud: Hands‑on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability.
  • Quality & DevOps: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments.
  • Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing).
  • Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client‑facing).
  • Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.

Nice To Have

  • Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
  • Spanish proficiency.
  • IaC (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
  • Multi‑cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
  • Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.g., Kafka), and feature flag management.

QUEM SOMOS:

A Fresenius Medical Care (FME) tem como propósito fundamental melhorar a vida dos pacientes com doença renal crônica (DRC), oferecendo-lhes um serviço integral, caracterizado pela mais alta tecnologia para o tratamento de diálise e o apoio permanente de uma equipe especializada, profissional e comprometida com a saúde do paciente.

Graças a este compromisso, a Fresenius Medical Care tornou-se a maior provedora mundial de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal crônica, uma doença que afeta a mais de 3,2 milhões de pessoas em todo o mundo. Provemos serviços de diálise por meio de mais de 3.928 clínicas de diálise em todos os continentes, atendendo a mais de 333.331 pacientes.

Enfermeiro(a) - Serviços Hospitalares

Bem como ser o facilitador no dia a dia do tratamento domiciliar, através de comunicação direta e precisa com o médico nefrologista e o Enfermeiro Supervisor SH responsáveis pelo paciente, atuando como elo da prestação de serviços SH e o acompanhamento durante o a sessão dialítica, condições clínicas e adequação do paciente e da família ao tratamento proposto.

title: Engineer Who Can Design - Americas
description:
Hi I’m Abhik, Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. As someone who could design and build software, this position is close to my heart. I always felt I had a unique perspective because I could play with design ideas and iterate in code. My ideas could start in Figma but then be grounded (or sometimes more creative) in code. My prototypes used actual logic and data. My changes cascaded throughout the app for comprehensive critique (thanks, React component system!). But, every company made me pick one —I couldn’t design and build. At Ashby, you can.

While every engineer can design and build, you’ll tackle our most challenging design problems and help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in‑house design system and consulting on bespoke work. To ground it with examples, engineers who can design at Ashby have:

  • Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using it to make the wireframes a reality.
  • Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build custom autocompletes. These autocompletes can contain filters, options to create new records, etc.
  • Helped another engineer improve their design’s information hierarchy and scannability for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies.

These projects reflect what we’re accomplishing at Ashby: improving the productivity of working professionals (starting with talent teams) with intelligent and powerful software. We put a lot of effort into designing products that are approachable to beginners but mastered & extended by power users. In many ways, spreadsheets set the bar here.

We have many customers, great revenue growth, years of runway, and amazing investors like YCombinator, Elad Gil, and Lachy Groom. I’ll share more once we meet.

This is a staff‑level role, so we require at least 5 years of experience as a full‑time frontend engineer or evenly split between frontend and design for this role and significant contributions to (or leading) design systems.

Engineering Culture

Our engineering culture is motivated by Benji’s (my co‑founder and CEO) and my belief that a small talented team, given the right environment, can build high‑quality software fast (and work regular hours!).

Collaboration is Natural & Communication is Deliberate

Our engineering team (and the team at large) consists of lifelong learners who are humble and kind (meet them here!). These attributes create an environment where collaboration happens naturally (we filter for it in interviews). We combine this with research, prototyping, and written proposals to see around corners and get feedback from the team across time zones. Focus time is something that we hold sacred, and, with thoughtful and deliberate communication, engineers spend less than 4 hours per week in meetings (I wrote about it here).

Increase Leverage, not Team Size

We built Ashby with the quality, breadth, and depth that many customers would expect from much larger teams over larger time scales. We’ve done this through investment in:

  • Great developer tooling. Our CI/CD takes ~10m, and we deploy at least 10x a day. Everyone on the team has contributed to developer experience.
  • Building blocks to create powerful and customizable products fast. At the core of Ashby is a set of common components (analytics modeling and query language, policy engine, workflow engine, design system) which we are constantly improving. Each improvement to a common component cascades throughout our app (short video below).

Here’s an impromptu quote from Arjun in our company Slack of what it’s like to build a feature at Ashby:

And a demo of one of these building blocks:

Give Engineers Ownership & Autonomy

We, as engineers, find clever ways to solve problems, which amplifies when we deeply understand the problem. Benji and I did our best work as engineers when we had a deep understanding of the end‑user and the business and ownership over the solution. Our engineering culture reflects this experience: engineers own projects end‑to‑end, from speaking with users to writing product specs to UX design. These are skills that we often don’t get to practice as engineers, and, at Ashby, we provide mentorship to grow them and help from the team where you want it.

Put Effort into Diversity

Diverse teams drive innovation and better outcomes. Having seen my mother and partner build their careers as minority women in non‑diverse fields, I want to make sure Ashby creates opportunities for the next generation of engineers from underrepresented groups (including my daughter!).

Today, 26% of engineers at Ashby are from underrepresented groups. It’s not great, and we are taking conscious steps to improve, like sourcing diverse candidates, providing generous paid family leave, no leetcode interviews, and more.

Interview Process

At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. We’ll dive into past projects and simulate working together via pair programming, writing tech specs collaboratively, and talking through decisions (no leetcode or whiteboard exercises). Our interview process is three rounds with some casual Zoom (or in‑person) coffee in between to get to know each other:

  • 30‑minute introduction call to discuss Ashby and your past work (we demo Ashby!)
  • A technical screen (take home or, for more experienced folks who want it, a 90‑minute live session)
  • A virtual on‑site of 3 hours and 45 minutes (can be split across two days)

Your hiring manager will be your main point of contact and prepare you for interviews. You’ll meet other engineering leaders and 4 to 6 engineers (with 15 minutes in each interview to ask them questions). If we don’t give an offer, we’ll provide feedback!

Your First Two Months at Ashby

We want an exceptional onboarding experience for every new hire. At Ashby, your dev environment sets up with a single script, you push your first change on day one, and we spend the rest of the time building your confidence in our codebase and practices culminating in delivering a prominent, impactful feature. We’ll pair you with a peer who’ll guide you through your first tasks and be someone you rely on, from answering questions to pair programming.

Technology Stack

Our tech stack is TypeScript (frontend & backend), React, a mix of SASS modules and Stitches, Apollo GraphQL, Node.js, Postgres, and Redis. We’re looking for folks with deep React, CSS, and HTML knowledge for this role.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity.
  • 10‑year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one‑on‑one agenda until you start taking it.
  • Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.
  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.
  • If you’re in the US, top‑notch health insurance for you and your dependents with all premiums covered by us.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Executar atividades de nutrição revisando os cardápios e dietas dos pacientes, bem como adequando o teor nutricional dos alimentos a fim de assegurar o atendimento das prescrições médicas.

Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino Superior Completo em Nutrição

Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Nutrição em Pediatria, Nutrição em Materno Infantil, Nutrição Clínica, Nutrição Geriatria e Gerontologia, Nutrição em Fitoterapia Nutricional ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde

Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Nutricionista.

Informações adicionais

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

  • Experience in quality control, with good technical knowledge for analysis of in-process product, finished product, imported product and HPLC methods.
  • Degree in pharmacy or chemistry

  • GMP Good Laboratory Practices
  • Knowledge of European regulations related to the analysis routine.

Você será o guardião da estabilidade e da inovação por trás dos sistemas que mantêm a Live Mode funcionando, conectando tecnologia, pessoas e inteligência artificial. Cada servidor otimizado, cada automação criada e cada rede segura ajudam a impulsionar não só nossa operação, mas também a maneira como o esporte é transmitido e vivido globalmente.

  • Manutenção e monitoramento da infraestrutura local: acompanhar o funcionamento dos equipamentos e sistemas internos, garantindo estabilidade, desempenho e disponibilidade dos serviços de TI.
  • Administração de redes: auxiliar na configuração e manutenção de redes LAN, Wi‑Fi, VPN, firewall, roteadores e switches, assegurando conectividade e segurança para os usuários.
  • Suporte técnico de N2 ou N3: atender e solucionar chamados e incidentes de usuários internos, oferecendo suporte técnico ágil e eficaz para diferentes áreas da empresa.
  • Gestão de ativos e inventário: manter atualizado o controle de hardware, licenças e equipamentos de TI, assegurando rastreabilidade e conformidade.
  • Apoio à segurança da informação: colaborar na implantação e manutenção de políticas e boas práticas de segurança, reforçando a proteção dos dados e sistemas corporativos.
  • Documentação técnica: criar e atualizar procedimentos, manuais e bases de conhecimento, facilitando a consulta e o compartilhamento interno de informações técnicas.
  • Integração com ferramentas de monitoramento: utilizar e manter sistemas de observabilidade como Zabbix e Grafana para acompanhar o desempenho da infraestrutura.
  • Apoio a projetos de infraestrutura: participar de iniciativas de migração, atualização e expansão de sistemas corporativos, contribuindo com suporte técnico e execução operacional.

  • Firewall e segurança: familiaridade com ferramentas como Fortigate ou Mikrotik para controle e proteção do tráfego de rede.

  • Open English oferece acesso a cursos de inglês ou espanhol em diversos formatos, com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e familiares.

Nossa cultura

Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte , e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo.

SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES

Ontem, hoje e sempre escolhemos o gol e corremos atrás dele com tudo. Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação? Direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo.

SOMOS UM TIME DE ALTA PERFORMANCE

Não uma família ou uma confraria de amigos. Família a gente não escolhe, mas o time escolhe quem joga. E quando o jogo é grande, não dá pra carregar quem não está entregando. Aqui, a gente decide pelo que é melhor para a empresa, não pra uma área ou pessoa. Toda entrega tem um dono claro, que vai até o fim. Processos ajudam, mas não mandam: quem resolve são as pessoas.

SOMOS AMBICIOSOS

Pensamos sempre grande. A gente já fez muita coisa grande. Mas quem está na LiveMode sabe que dá pra ir além. Porque quem é ambicioso de verdade vive com a sensação de que sempre dá pra melhorar, crescer, fazer mais impacto. Aqui, a ambição não é discurso. É prática. E é ela que nos leva a quebrar recorde atrás de recorde.

O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO

Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade. Queremos ser uma empresa IA first, porque acreditamos que dominar essas ferramentas não é opcional — é o que vai nos ajudar a alcançar nossa missão mais rápido. IA não é extra. É parte central do nosso dia a dia.

Regional Accountant

Finance Manager

Job Summary

The Regional Accountant is responsible for the timely and accurate preparation of Seadrill’s profit and loss, balance sheet and identified phased financial reports. This should be performed in line with the targets set within the Service Level Agreement (SLA) related to the Accounting Shared Service Centre. The role will mainly involve ownership of at least one rig with assigned Legal Entities (LEs), preparing both the P&L results (KPI) and phased financial balance sheet reviews. The Regional Accountant will be the focal point of contact for the Rig Controller in their respective region.

  • Maintain the integrity of the general ledger including the preparation, verification, and input of journal entries.
  • Responsible for monthly, quarterly and annual closing.

  • Prepare periodic reporting/statutory accounts analysis for 4 legal entities as requested.
  • Perform monthly review of payroll accruals ensuring the related accounts are reconciled.
  • Analyze rechargeable items, prepare and issue invoices and post related journal entries.
  • Prepare and file SPED Contábil – ECD.
  • Assist with internal and external audits.
  • Keep intercompany recharges up to date, prepare and issue invoices, post journal entries and include all information in AGIS module.
  • Register intercompany payable and related import taxes.
  • Be a key team member driving continuous improvement. Participation in assigned projects.

Skills and Experience

  • Strong organisational and people management skills.
  • 1+ year(s) experience in accounting specific role.
  • Experience working with a global ERP system.
  • Working knowledge of US GAAP and IFRS.
  • Experience in a shared services environment.
  • Experience in a public company environment.
  • Ability to work under pressure.
  • Understanding of and experience with statutory reporting requirements.
  • Ability to take initiative and work on tasks independently or as part of a team.
  • Excellent customer relations skills.
  • Good problem solving skills.

Desired

  • Experience in oil field services (preference within drilling sector).
  • Experience with Oracle and Hyperion.
  • Experience of working with diverse regional teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting.
  • English fluency.

Safety at Seadrill

Our goal is to ensure that nobody gets hurt whilst performing their job. Everyone has a part to play in meeting our safety commitment. Through strong leadership and personal responsibility from all employees, we take a systematic approach to identifying, managing and preventing hazards involved in our day-to-day operations...

Behavioral Framework

Benefits

We value our people and want to retain them, so we offer a competitive package built around an attractive base salary and a range of benefits tailored to your location.

Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

Our implementation accounting team acts as the bridge between sales and long‑term account management for new fund clients. Ours is a team of folks who have mastery of accounting, exhibit a high degree of problem‑solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject‑matter expertise to provide customers with a world‑class onboarding experience.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent experience.

  • Ability to build strong client relationships through transparent and forthright communication. Able to manage multiple clients while hitting deadlines and providing white‑glove service.
  • Passionate about growing and advancing with Carta.
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success.
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously.

title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
Focusing on offshore and onshore logistics operations, this position will plan, coordinate, and execute the movement of materials, equipment, and personnel. The role will lead the logistics team and oversee all logistics aspects, including vessel, helicopter, and shorebase contracts and monitoring, ensuring efficient day-to-day operations, timely and cost-effective deliveries, optimized cargo planning, and accurate logistics documentation and reporting.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and execute logistics operations for the transportation of materials, equipment, and personnel between onshore bases, warehouses, ports, and offshore units.
  • Manage and oversee vessel contracts, ensuring effective day-to-day coordination, performance monitoring, and operational efficiency.
  • Manage and oversee helicopter contracts, ensuring safe and timely operations in line with company requirements.
  • Manage and oversee shorebase contracts, monitoring performance and ensuring service quality and compliance.
  • Lead the logistics team and all logistics activities, driving efficiency, cost optimization, and alignment with project and operational needs.
  • Ensure full compliance with company policies, customs regulations, import/export legislation, and health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards.
  • Monitor freight movements (road, sea, and air) and ensure timely deliveries and collections to support operations.
  • Liaise with freight forwarders, customs brokers, port authorities, and internal stakeholders to optimize logistics planning and execution.
  • Prepare and verify shipping documents, including invoices, packing lists, manifests, and customs clearance forms.
  • Follow up on material requisitions, dispatches, returns, and cargo tracking using ERP systems and logistics software.
  • Coordinate and optimize cargo consolidation and manifest planning to reduce freight costs and improve turnaround.
  • Ensure proper packaging, labeling, and preservation of materials in accordance with applicable standards and offshore requirements.
  • Control documentation for hazardous materials (IMO/ADR/IATA) and ensure safe transport in compliance with regulations.
  • Track inventory movements between locations and support warehouse activities when required.
  • Maintain accurate records of all shipments, freight costs, delays, and delivery KPIs.
  • Support the preparation of logistics procedures, manuals, and compliance reports.
  • Assist in contractor performance evaluation and cost control initiatives within the logistics function.
  • Participate in daily/weekly operations meetings to align logistics activities with planning and operational needs.
  • Respond to operational challenges and emergencies, proposing mitigation measures and alternative logistics solutions.
  • Coordinate crew change logistics when required, including travel, immigration, and accommodation arrangements.
  • Provide logistics support for regulatory inspections or audits related to customs, cargo, and HSE.

Education

  • Technical or university degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or related field.

Experience

  • Experience in logistics coordination, preferably in oil & gas.
  • Familiarity with freight forwarding, customs clearance, and offshore logistics operations.

description:
Join to apply for the Marketing Operations QA Specialist role at Launch Potato.

WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is a profitable digital media company that reaches over 30M+ monthly visitors through brands such as FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data‑driven content and technology. Headquartered in South Florida with a remote‑first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high‑growth, high‑performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high‑performers.

CONTRACT NON‑NEGOTIABLES

  • Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday – Friday.
  • Comfortable to work between 7:00 am and 6:00 pm Eastern Standard Time.
  • Outstanding communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills in English, both written and spoken.
  • Highly detail‑oriented and reliable.
  • Excellent administrative skills with the ability to multitask and adapt in a fast‑paced remote environment.

BASE SALARY

$1,500 – $2,500 (USD) per month.

YOUR ROLE

You are a detail‑oriented, results‑driven professional with a passion for maintaining the highest standards of quality and efficiency in operational processes and procedures. Everything goes through QA, so you will be directly responsible for ensuring the success of our campaign launches, which connect millions of consumers to our clients monthly. You will also oversee and optimize our operations to meet and exceed industry standards and organizational objectives. Your unwavering attention to detail and thorough analysis skills will be invaluable in detecting and identifying potential problems within our daily operations. You have a proven track record in quality management, process improvement, and possess industry‑specific knowledge. Your ability to collaborate and work cross‑functionally, leveraging your industry‑specific expertise, will enable you to implement effective solutions and make a significant impact on our company’s operational excellence.

SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Supporting quality assurance for our financebuzz.com and allaboutcookies.org domains.
  • Maintaining the process for building, setting up, and testing tracking URLs across all campaigns and platforms to ensure the highest quality.
  • Reconciling reporting between our internal tracking platforms and external client platforms to ensure proper tracking.
  • Conducting investigations when there is an offer discrepancy or malfunction and finding suitable resolutions.
  • Reviewing platform documentation and internal product setup to find areas of improvement and working with the Operations team to determine next steps to close the gap.
  • Working closely with the Operations team to ensure QA standards are consistently met.
  • Communicating with internal stakeholders on process improvements.
  • Analyzing ad‑hoc performance reports to improve company efficiency of revenue delivery, product improvement, or general site issues.
  • Monitoring revenue, conversions, impressions, and clicks to ensure proper reporting when a new offer is created, links are changed, or in other necessary circumstances.
  • Monitoring offer goals to ensure all goals are firing properly after creation.
  • Ensuring QA is successfully implemented with any new process that is rolled out.
  • Quickly becoming a subject‑matter expert for all QA‑related processes.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

  • 2–3 years in operations or quality assurance with expertise in digital media advertising.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Understanding of Postback URL tracking and other performance marketing methods of tracking.
  • Experience with Tune & Yieldspark or similar tracking tools.
  • Experience with Asana or other project management tools.
  • Experience with Looker or similar BI tools like Tableau or PowerBI.
  • Proven ability to analyze performance reports to improve company efficiency of revenue delivery, product improvement, or general site issues.
  • Proven problem‑solving ability and #BetterEveryDay mindset.
  • Proactive mindset, searching for opportunities, not just being given tasks/tickets.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills.
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to work East Coast hours consistently.

APPLY NOW!

Since day one, we’ve been committed to having a diverse, inclusive team and culture. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity company. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, or other legally protected characteristics.

Quem somos?

Somos líderes em construção, reforma e operação de infraestrutura hospitalar, pioneiros em modernizar hospitais por meio de parcerias público-privadas. Em parceria com o Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar, o maior hospital de emergência da América Latina, estamos redefinindo os padrões de atendimento em saúde.

O que buscamos?

Estamos buscando profissionais talentosos e experientes para nosso Banco de Talentos de Oficial de Manutenção. O objetivo é identificar e ter em nosso cadastro candidatos com sólido conhecimento em manutenção predial em geral, com experiência em um ou mais ofícios (como alvenaria, pintura, marcenaria, serralheria, etc.), preferencialmente em ambientes hospitalares.   • Estamos buscando profissionais talentosos e experientes para nosso Banco de Talentos de Oficial de Manutenção. Dia a Dia

O profissional selecionado para vagas futuras poderá exercer atividades de manutenção preventiva e corretiva que envolvam:

  • Pintura: Preparar superfícies, aplicar tintas, massas, vernizes e outros produtos de acabamento.
  • Alvenaria e Acabamentos: Assentar tijolos, blocos, reboco, pisos, azulejos e outros revestimentos. Realizar reparos civis em telhados, lajes e calçadas.
  • Marcenaria: Analisar, confeccionar e reparar móveis e peças, trabalhando a madeira, armando partes e finalizando acabamentos.
  • Serralheria: Interpretar desenhos, realizar cortes em metais, aplicar técnicas de soldagem, modelar e montar estruturas metálicas, corrimões e grades.
  • Geral: Realizar pequenos reparos de alvenaria, hidráulica (simples) e elétrica (simples), e consertos de rachaduras e buracos. Organizar, limpar e manter o local de trabalho seguro. Seguir rigorosamente as normas de segurança no local de trabalho (incluindo o uso de EPIs) e procedimentos hospitalares. Auxiliar em outras tarefas de manutenção predial conforme a necessidade.

Uma carreira na Equinix significa colaborar em projetos que impactam o mundo, com infinitas oportunidades para aprender novas habilidades e crescer em diversas direções. Valorizamos a diversidade de pensamento e contribuição, e estamos comprometidos em proporcionar um ambiente de trabalho equitativo — essencial para os nossos valores e para o nosso sucesso.

Como um Analista de Customer Success Sênior na Equinix, o profissional atuará de forma estratégica em três pilares fundamentais para o negócio:

  • Relacionamento com Clientes Field Sales: prestará atendimento direto aos clientes das contas de Field Sales — clientes estratégicos e de grande porte da Equinix, garantindo uma experiência de excelência desde o primeiro contato.
  • Apoio ao time de vendas com foco em upselling: atuará lado a lado com a equipe comercial, identificando oportunidades de expansão e propondo soluções com melhor custo-benefício, sempre com foco nas necessidades do cliente.

Utilizará discernimento para adaptar a melhor abordagem de interação com os clientes, considerando suas necessidades e o escopo do projeto.

Seguirá a Metodologia de 3 Fases:

  1. Fase 1 – Pré-integração: Realizará atividades preparatórias com todos os clientes.
  2. Fase 2 – Reunião Inicial: Agendará, facilitará e conduzirá reuniões de início de integração.
  3. Fase 3 – Acompanhamento Contínuo: Estabelecerá uma cadência regular de contato para acompanhar a evolução dos clientes.

Poderá liderar integrações em diferentes regiões, em parceria com outros Gerentes de Sucesso do Cliente (CSMs).

Identificará tendências e utilizará perguntas estratégicas para aprofundar o entendimento do negócio.

Background

  • The Technician is responsible for executing maintenance and preservation tasks efficiently and safely to ensure the reliability and longevity of equipment.   • The technician is also responsible for ensuring that his supervisor is made aware of all activities according to procedure, especially when safety is an issue.
  • The technician/operator will demonstrate exemplary safety awareness and technical competence in all aspects of maintenance and preservation work on and around the vessel.

Authority

Immediate Subordinates

  • Subcontractors, Visitors, Vendor Representatives

Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards

  • 1) Dismantle and Reassemble Instrumentation Equipment
  • 1Identify potential sources of hazard prior to dismantling.
  • 2Use correct procedures and correct method of dismantling.
  • 3Carry out the correct isolation and disconnection procedure.
  • 4Identify, check and prepare components.
  • 5Apply appropriate tests and test equipment to ensure reassembly is correct and effective.
  • 2) Monitor and Maintain the condition of Instrumentation Equipment.
  • 1Adjust instruments to meet the operating specification.
  • 2Adjust with minimum disruption to any ongoing activities and minimum waste of resources.
  • 3Monitor and record what has been carried out in work history or log.
  • 3) Diagnose Faults in Equipment.
  • 1Respond promptly to problems in line with approved procedures.
  • 2Select appropriate tests and diagnostic procedures and apply them methodically.

title: Financial Analyst
description:
We’re helping an international finance and M&A consultancy find a Financial Analyst to support transaction advisory, fundraising, and strategic finance projects for high-growth startups and scaleups.

You’ll build sophisticated financial models, prepare investor and board materials, and support valuation and deal execution across software and deeptech companies. This is a hands‑on, high‑accountability role where flawless work is non‑negotiable — your analyses will directly inform key decisions and client strategies.

This role is ideal for someone who is a wizard with numbers , detail‑obsessed yet commercially minded, and capable of seeing both the story and strategy behind the spreadsheets .

Part time to start, 24 hours/week (with potential to transition to full time)
Schedule: CET working hours
Location: Fully Remote
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Compensation: $1440-$2200 (based on a 24‑hour workweek, depending on level of experience); $2400-$3680 for full time

Key Responsibilities

  • Financial Modelling (Forecast & Scenario Analysis)
    Build fully linked 3‑statement financial models with sensitivities and scenarios (base, downside, management).
    Create cash flow forecasts, liquidity bridges, and valuation‑ready modules (DCF, comps, transaction comps).

  • Historical Restatement & Data Hygiene
    Reconcile and clean raw data (GL exports, bank data, SaaS metrics) into analysis‑ready formats.
    Maintain version control, audit trails, and traceability from trial balance to model.

  • Reporting Templates & Automation
    Design board and investor reporting templates, KPI dashboards, and variance analysis frameworks.
    Build SaaS metrics (ARR/MRR bridges, churn, LTV/CAC, NRR) and recurring revenue templates.

  • Transaction Support (Model‑Led)
    Produce deal‑ready schedules for buy‑side and sell‑side engagements (QofE, NWC, closing adjustments).
    Translate model outputs into charts and visuals for investment memorandums and management presentations.

  • Quality Assurance & Standards
    Follow strict QA processes (FAST/SMART methodology).
    Double‑check every formula, input, and output — your work must be flawless .
    Ensure transparency through consistent assumptions pages, error checks, and version logs.

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of experience in M&A, Transaction Services, or FP&A , ideally from a Tier 1 investment bank or M&A boutique .

    • Candidates with more years of experience will also be considered if they remain flexible and open to new approaches.

  • Strong experience working with software companies ; exposure to deeptech (e.g., chipmakers) is a plus.

  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets proficiency (array formulas, Power Query, dynamic formulas, structured refs).

  • Excellent grasp of valuation and deal mechanics (NWC, closing adjustments, leakage, earn‑outs).

  • Ability to turn messy data into clear historicals and models — quickly and accurately.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills — able to explain the story behind the numbers.

  • Meticulous attention to detail and ability to self‑check work before submission.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience preparing materials for investment memorandums (IMs).

  • Familiarity with CAPEX modelling and debt structuring.

  • Previous experience in software or SaaS transactions ; exposure to deeptech deals a bonus.

How Our Client Works

  • Theyown the numbers — every figure must be backed by logic, traceability, and quality assurance.

  • Theybalance precision with practicality — models should be easy to hand over and fast to update.

  • Theytranslate numbers into narratives — this role will eventually expand into creating investment memorandums where financial insights tell the story.

Recruitment Process

  1. Initial Interview

  2. Finance Case + bonus assignment

  3. Second Interview

  4. Valuation Case Test

  5. Final Interview

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS)
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM)
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops)

  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team
  • Prepare and manage a health- and safety plan
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments

YOUR PROFILE

You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper-focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You'll work on our Performance Creative service—our AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

  • Sales: Deliver game changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50-100 new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. You will also work with both our Social Commerce team to enhance UGC creative and our Paid Media team to plug into their ad scaling strategies. Generally, your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance - combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you’ll do:

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high-tempo creative strategy and direction for full-funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.

  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short-form video.

  • Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb-stop rate, hold rate, and clickthrough rate. You’re super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content. You’re capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn’t the role for strategy-only folks.

  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short-form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short-form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low-fidelity creative.

  • You can storyboard, cut, and ship ads. You can jump into Figma to fix hierarchy and pacing, and into Photoshop or Illustrator to polish assets. Strategy-only folks will not be a fit.

  • You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb-stop rate, 3-second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

  • You already use tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped ads with AI-assisted elements, not just experiments.

  • You’re an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to clients. You give crisp, actionable feedback to designers and editors and know how to navigate pushback from clients

  • You can turn vague goals into testable concepts, track results, and call the next iteration without hand-holding.

  • Deep in Figma including Auto Layout, Components, and handoff. Strong in Adobe Creative Suite.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No portfolio link or no performance context.

  • Strategy-only with no hands-on design ability.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
  • Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.
  • Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

title: Host Broadcast Production Manager
description:
Host Broadcast Production Manager

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament.

This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the on-going development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On-going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast-related overlay. As well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on-site of the host broadcaster.
  • Work closely with the overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to ensure you are the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio De Janeiro FIFA office, Work closely with the Media Partners and Relations department and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervision, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Main point of contact for Project Lead and the Host Broadcaster, liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, issue resolutions, etc.
  • Pre-planning, onsite support and delivery for the Play off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).
  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering excellent client service, with clear examples of supporting the needs of multiple business units.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high-pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high-quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

NICE TO HAVES

PERKS AND BENEFITS

description:
Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work‑life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

About the Role

We are seeking a QA Automation Engineer to join our rapidly growing telemedicine platform and help maintain the highest standards of product quality across our digital healthcare solutions. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks that support both web and mobile applications. You will play a key part in driving our automation strategy, integrating tests within our CI/CD pipeline, and collaborating closely with cross‑functional teams to deliver high‑quality releases.

This is a hands‑on role that requires both technical expertise and strategic thinking. You’ll work alongside developers, product managers, and DevOps to identify quality risks early, resolve issues efficiently, and continuously improve our QA processes. The ideal candidate is someone who takes initiative, communicates clearly, and thrives in a fast‑paced, fully remote environment. If you are passionate about automation, healthcare innovation, and making an impact through quality engineering, this is an excellent opportunity to join a mission‑driven team.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and robust test automation frameworks.
  • Write, execute, and maintain automated tests for web, mobile, and API applications.
  • Collaborate with developers and product managers to create comprehensive test plans.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous testing and fast releases.
  • Conduct performance and load testing to ensure system reliability.
  • Identify, document, and track software defects, collaborating with development teams to resolve them.
  • Generate reports on test coverage, automation progress, and product quality metrics.
  • Continuously improve QA tools, methodologies, and documentation processes.

Must Haves

  • 5+ years of experience as a QA Automation Engineer.
  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and spoken).

  • Hands‑on experience with tools like Playwright (preferred), Robot, Selenium, or Postman.

  • Understanding of RESTful APIs and ability to write automated API tests.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. Most of Carta's long‑term success will come from products and technology that have yet to be built. Here is an incomplete list of how you might contribute:

You’ll work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure we’re building the right thing at the right time with the right people. Your contributions will enable Carta's mission to make equity more available and accessible to everyone.

The Team You’ll Work With

This role sits on our Data Integrations team, building the necessary network infrastructure for the flow of financial and HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) data into and out of Carta, powering the entire company management experience.

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Product, Business, and Design. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross‑functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027").

The position

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament. This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

Your profile

Your profile

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.

  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering excellent client service, with clear examples of supporting the needs of multiple business units.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high-pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high-quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.
